- Day 2 (Integration lab): 6-hour hands-on; connectors, sample deployment templates, CI checks (owner: Sean) — target 2026-06-09
- Week 2 (follow-up): 1:1 office hours, final handoff artifacts, certification checklist completed — target 2026-06-18

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm SI roster (ConsultIQ, plus two others) by 2026-05-21
2) Provide any compliance questionnaire upfront so Marissa can pre-populate answers
3) Share any special dataset constraints (PII/no-PII)

Attachments included: EmbedderOps-Integration-Checklist.xlsx; I attached the slide deck draft for the enablement session (SI-Enablement-Session-Deck.pptx) to help frame the lab.
